literal_meaning: তিল (সিম) থেকে তিল (সিম) তিলোত্তমা (পৌরাণিক সৌন্দর্যের প্রতীক)
figurative_meaning_en: Exquisite beauty created gradually from tiny elements
similar_in_english: A masterpiece pieced together bit by bit
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাড়ির সাজসজ্জা তিলে তিলে তিলোত্তমা হয়েছে।
এই ছবিটি তিলে তিলে তিলোত্তমা, প্রতিটি অংশ সুন্দর।
example_sentences_in_english: Her home decoration has become a Tilottama created sesame by sesame.
This painting is a Tilottama formed bit by bit, every part beautiful.
history: The idiom draws from Hindu mythology where Tilottama, an Apsara, was created by gods from the particles of sesame seeds (tila), symbolizing unparalleled beauty formed meticulously from the smallest components.
note: References the mythical figure Tilottama from the Puranas, emphasizing incremental perfection in beauty.
